test_title: PYST 25: SSC CGL 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 08 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘FANCY’ is written as ‘ACPEH’ and ‘TRACTOR’ is written as ‘TTCEVQV’. How will ‘CARROT’ be written in that language?
solution:
According to the English alphabets & their positional values:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7d12502c2ca7d9724c6b72807e815218baf7d8f4c343b106b5314067691645b.png] 

The pattern followed in the given codes is:

**The alphabets are increased by + 2 **

**First and last alphabets are interchanged.**

‘FANCY’ is written as ‘ACPEH’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a2cc302725d6bc1f2117b94f8be2714ae279ea7f8601acea2b78270f6c4e400.png] 

‘TRACTOR’ is written as ‘TTCEVQV’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f2bdc0fca1e65dbdffa117d3bf7135d5d13209c5a08ac11761768f46252c5bb1.png] 

Similarly, for ‘CARROT’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2199d0207628346f3f32f9a295dc804fe2c6c43c940767410abc055aea40cd86.png] 

So, ‘CARROT’ will be coded as 'VCTTQE'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
